headline: A 1,391 Million Dollar Inflow Puts Coins Onto Crypto Exchanges
narrative: Crypto exchanges took in 1,391 million dollars over 24 hours, equal to 0.5143 percent of reserves. The spot pipe read as a heavy inflow, coins arriving on venues, a distribution print. Bitcoin exchange reserves stood at 1,278,368 after a seven-day rise of 29,337 coins, while bitcoin traded near 81k.
author: jordan
